Enum Class SpinnerStyle

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SpinnerStyle>
org.casserole.chat.SpinnerStyle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SpinnerStyle>, Constable
public enum SpinnerStyle extends Enum<SpinnerStyle>
The SpinnerStyle type names the in-place thinking animation for a VT100 terminal. VT100 is the terminal control set the chat shell paints with. The property casserole.chat.spinner selects the style. BRAILLE cycles ten Braille dot glyphs, and the client font must contain those glyphs. ASCII cycles |, /, -, and \\. ASCII is the style used when the property is missing or unrecognized. NONE stores no frames, so the animation does not run.

    • fromProperty

      public static SpinnerStyle fromProperty(String raw)
      The fromProperty method reads the casserole.chat.spinner property. If raw is null, the result is ASCII. Leading and trailing spaces are removed before the text is compared. If the remaining text is braille, ignoring case, the result is BRAILLE. If the remaining text is none, ignoring case, the result is NONE. Any other text selects ASCII.
      Parameters:
      raw - The property value, or null when the property is absent.
      Returns:
      The matching style, and never null.
